name: sure
description: Agent skills and an MCP connection for Sure, the open-source personal finance app: self-hosting, the MCP financial tools, and the REST API.

interface.longDescription: Skills and an MCP server config for Sure, the community-driven personal finance app. Covers self-hosting with Docker Compose (secret and encryption keys, host and origin restrictions, signup mode, the AI compose file with Pipelock); connecting assistants to Sure's /mcp endpoint with OAuth or a static token and using its account, transaction, budget, rule and statement tools safely with dry runs and preview tokens; and scripting the /api/v1 REST API with API keys, including transaction filters and regenerating the rswag OpenAPI spec.
defaultPrompt: Self-host Sure with Docker on my server
What did I spend on groceries last month in Sure?
Create a Sure rule that categorizes my Uber rides as Transport
